text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Yaeno Muteki joins us in
training as she and Sakura Chiyono O
make the final
preparations for their
debut.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The way you accelerate at the end is
amazing, Yaeno! Watching you is
teaching me so much
about how to use
my legs properly!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The pleasure is all mine.
choice_data_list: Thanks for keeping me company today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It is through daily training that we are
able to shape our strength, and I'm
grateful to have had
the opportunity to
work with you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I promised my grandfather that I would
improve myself at Tracen Academy, so I
cannot neglect
my training for a single
day.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Correct.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Interesting... Hm...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Looks like it resonated with Chiyo...
Looks like it resonated with Chiyo...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Hehe... Did you see me writing that
down?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Heh... If he knew the aspirations of our
martial style resonated with you as well,
Grampa—my
grandfather would be
proud.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, I've heard that you're
Maruzensky's beloved disciple. I have a
feeling you already
have a goal
established within you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Just as I seek out challenges that
embody the peak of the racing world, in
order to show how much I've learned in
my races thus far, so too
must you—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The Derby. My dream is to run in the
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For a moment, the wind comes to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen entrusted that dream to me, so
I won't
let anyone else have that race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno. How about we run 2,400 meters
next, the
same length as the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't expecting her to make such a
suggestion. As her trainer, I know better
than to let her run
that, so I hurriedly
interject.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Awww, what? Does this mean you're not
letting
me do it?
choice_data_list: It's still too early for you at th...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that they're finally race-ready, it
seems the two of them are eager to test
their limits, but they're not considering
the strain they might put
on their bodies.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It won't do if they overexert and exhaust

themselves, so I have make sure I
supervise and
limit how much they train.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Can't we run just a little of it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Aww... Fine...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Was that a flicker of fear I felt just
now? Just from
looking into Chiyono O's
eyes?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of Sakura Chiyono O's
debut!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I take both the distance of the race
and the weather into account, the speed
at which I should
run down the final
stretch should be...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! These Chiyonotes contain all
my
priceless proverbs and training
details!
choice_data_list: You've been staring at that notebo...
You've been staring at that notebo...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've got to keep prepping until the last
second! "Treat each step as a step
toward the
Derby"—those are my words
to live by!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
There's plenty of time until the starting
gates
open, so I'm going to continue
reviewing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Well, yeah. I am.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's about the only saving grace I
have.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I don't possess any outstanding natural
talent, so
I have no choice but to work
hard every day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: Considering that, you say some pre...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Sorry about putting you on the
spot then,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...But the Derby is the one race I have to
win, no
matter what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From what happened recently with
Yaeno Muteki,
I know how sincere her
wish is.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The Derby. My dream is to run in the
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The second Maruzensky was brought up,
the look
in her eyes completely
changed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Of course not! Well, I'm off to the

paddock!
choice_data_list: You're an Umamusume who refuses to...
You're an Umamusume who will never...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O puts down her hefty
notebook
and phone on the desk, and
she heads off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her notebook, stuffed with all sorts of
sticky notes and papers, embodies all
the hard work she's put in... as well as
her desire for what's to
come.
